summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Quick Start (2025 Update) - p08 Automatic Try-On Feature ## Introduction to Automatic Window Display The automatic window display is fundamental to the functionality of the Marvelous Designer software. This feature allows users to interactively display a virtual model within the 3D window. ## Displaying the Virtual Model To display the virtual model, move the mouse to the 3D window and click to activate the virtual model window display. The virtual model's body surface is covered with a layer of natural invisible clothing. ### Impact on Clothing Design While this invisible clothing does not directly affect the garments you create, it utilizes model body data to help you quickly adjust clothing sizes to fit various virtual models with different body types. ## Window Display Information for Imported Models When using Marvelous Designer, the virtual model comes with a window display. If you import a model from an external source that lacks window display information, the software can automatically generate this information upon import. This feature works effectively when importing standard A-Pose or T-Pose models. ### Editing the Window Display Occasionally, the automatic window display may not meet your expectations. This can happen if the pose is unique or if body recognition fails when using A-Pose or T-Pose models. In such cases, manual adjustments are needed. 1. Click on the virtual model image in the menu bar. 2. Select the virtual model editor. 3. Navigate to the window display label page. You will see purple measurement lines on the model body. These lines help identify areas that may not be perfectly recognized. ### Modifying Measurement Lines If you find any measurement lines that require modification: - Click on the name of the part that needs adjustment. - Add a new purple measurement line to the model body, which will replace the original measurement line. After completing your checks, click on the window display button. The model body will now be covered with the updated window display. If there are gaps between the window screen and the model body, you can adjust it accordingly. ## Saving Model Data Once the adjustments are made, the model body and its window display information can be saved in the .apt format. This allows you to easily access the model with its window display information in future sessions. ### Clothing Window Display Open the clothing window display to observe that the clothing is also covered with a red window display. ## Using the Virtual Model Function To see the virtual model in action, press Shift + A to display the virtual model named Hanna, which has already been loaded. This enables you to test the virtual model function in the 3D window. ### Automatic Clothing Fit It is important to note that while the clothes are automatically donned onto the virtual model, they may not fit perfectly. The fitting does not automatically adjust the clothing to conform to the model; as a result, the clothes may appear too tight or too loose. ## Troubleshooting Clothing Fit To assess the fitting, press Alt + 6 to check the hard drive. If the clothes appear too loose, you can revert to the previous step by pressing G. ### Adjusting Particle Diameter You have the option to increase the particle diameter of the clothing, which can enhance the calculation speed for fitting adjustments. ## Automatic Adjustment in the 2D Window Next, we will operate the automatic adjustment of the panel in the 2D window. Press C to select the relevant functions, and you will notice that the clothing lines become more harmonious with the virtual model. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching! We will see you next time as we continue exploring Marvelous Designer. ```
